title: Dinosaurs in Space? Star Trek's New Season Has Scary Ghosts and Puppet Trouble Too!
summary:
Have you ever wondered what would happen if the crew of the Starship Enterprise met dinosaurs? That's just one of the wild adventures in the new season of Star Trek: Strange New Worlds! Season 4 kicked off on July 23, 2026, and the showrunners—the people in charge of the stories—promise it's the most exciting one yet.

In the first episode, called "Valles Marineris," the crew encounters dinosaurs. "The minute we started talking about doing dinosaurs, we were like, 'Yeah, let's figure out a way to do that,'" said Henry Alonso Myers, one of the showrunners. They love mixing different genres, so this season also has a spooky ghost story episode called "The Griffin Incident." It's filmed like a horror movie, with a creepy, Lovecraftian feel—meaning there are mysterious, scary things lurking just out of sight.

But it's not all monsters. The characters grow a lot too. Uhura, who started as a new recruit, now takes charge and saves lives in ways we've never seen. And there are emotional moments between Dr. M'Benga and Nurse Chapel that deepen their friendship. The show even has a noir crime thriller and a funny episode with puppet mishaps!

Myers and his partner Akiva Goldsman say they were inspired by 1990s movies and wanted every episode to feel fresh. "It's hard to come up through the '90s and not feel affected by a lot of the films that came out in that era," Myers explained. So if you love space adventures with heart, humor, and a little bit of fright, this season is for you. You can stream it now on Paramount+.
why_it_matters: It shows how storytelling can mix fun, scary, and emotional moments to teach lessons about bravery and friendship, and it encourages kids to use their imagination.

background_read: The Star Trek franchise has been telling stories about space exploration since the 1960s, inspiring generations of fans.
Strange New Worlds is a newer series that takes place on the starship Enterprise before the events of the original show, with Captain Pike in command.
The show is famous for experimenting with different genres in each episode, from comedy to horror, much like some 1990s TV series did.

WHAT: The new season includes episodes with dinosaurs, a ghost story, a noir crime thriller, and puppet comedy.
WHERE: On the TV series Star Trek: Strange New Worlds, available to stream on Paramount+.

perspectives.description: The season promises thrilling, funny, and spooky stories that keep viewers excited and guessing what will happen next.
Watching Uhura grow from a new recruit into a confident leader shows that practice and courage can pay off over time.
Some might worry that mixing too many styles could make the show feel messy, but the creators say it keeps each episode feeling fresh and new.
